title: box3d-flow-study/1
description: A flow study for box3d-webgpu-kit/flow (runFlowStudy, the box3d-flow command). SI units: m, s, kg, N, Pa. Unknown fields are errors. See docs/FLOW.md.

item.description: A primitive or a triangle mesh. Metres, the frame of the study (any; +y up by default).

part.description: Name of the part the item belongs to (default "body"). Forces and surfaces are reported per part.

role.description: solid (default), or cavity: the inside is fluid, and everything outside the union of the cavities is solid (pipes drawn by their bore, tanks, tunnels).

id.description: Carried unchanged to setup.geometry.report (the element id in the model).

size.description: FULL extents along the local x, y, z, m.

box.description: A box; exactly one of size and halfExtents.

up.description: Direction of the depth. Default: the world axis least aligned with the member.

flange.description: Flange thickness of an I section, m.

web.description: Web thickness of an I section, m.

part.description: Name of the part the item belongs to (default "body"). Forces and surfaces are reported per part.

role.description: solid (default), or cavity: the inside is fluid, and everything outside the union of the cavities is solid (pipes drawn by their bore, tanks, tunnels).

id.description: Carried unchanged to setup.geometry.report (the element id in the model).

positions.description: x, y, z per vertex, m.

indices.description: Three vertex indices per triangle. Without it every three vertices are a triangle.

file.description: A mesh file (.stl, .obj, or .json with positions and indices) resolved by the loadMesh option (the command line reads it relative to the study file). Instead of positions.

thickness.description: Thickness of an open surface, m (0: none given; it is a shell grown to the thinnest wall the lattice sees). A closed component ignores it. Without it an open component is filled by ray parity, with a warning.

position.description: Translation applied after rotation and scale.

closed.description: true: a closed solid; false: an open surface.

thickness.description: Thickness of an open surface, m; 0 none.

elements.description: Runs of triangles from one model element (the layout of an apex-flow-geometry/1 mesh): each closed, or open with a thickness. Triangles in no run take the mesh thickness.

document.description: An apex-flow-geometry/1 document (metres, +y up, quaternions xyzw).

file.description: A JSON file holding one, read by the loadDocument option (the command line: relative to the study).

role.description: Of every item of the document. Default solid.

partName.description: Part names from the layer id (default) or name.

parts.description: Part indices to keep. Default all.

apex.description: The primitives and meshes of an apex-flow-geometry/1 document: boxes with FULL sizes, flat-ended cylinders and capsules along local +y with their full length, meshes with their per-element closed flags and thicknesses. Exactly one of document and file.

normal.description: OUTWARD normal of the fluid domain: out of the fluid through the opening.
OUTWARD normal of the fluid domain.

up.description: Direction of halfHeight in the plane.

shape.description: An opening: a disc or a rectangle in a plane. The cells within 2.5 cells outside the plane and inside the shape become the opening.

oneOf.description: Points origin + s u + t v at the centres of an nu x nv grid.

profile.description: uniform (default), or parabolic (= developed): 1 - (r/R)^2 on a disc, (1 - (x/a)^2)(1 - (y/b)^2) on a rectangle, scaled to the flow rate or mean speed given.

geometry.description: The solids (and cavities). Required for an external study.

oneOf.description: Exactly one of viscosity and dynamicViscosity.

direction.description: Direction the fluid moves toward (normalised). Default [1, 0, 0].

up.description: Lift axis, along one coordinate axis. Default [0, 1, 0].

height.description: Coordinate along up, m. Default: the lowest point of the geometry.

type.description: fixed (default): a no-slip floor; moving: slides with the stream; slip: a symmetry plane.

ground.description: A ground plane normal to up; the geometry below it is removed. Default false.

length.description: The length the margins are multiples of, m. Default: referenceLength when given, else the body size across the flow.

margins.description: Free space around the bounding box of the geometry, in multiples of length.

domain.description: The box itself, instead of margins.

referenceLength.description: m: the Reynolds number, the moment coefficients and (by default) the length of the margins. Default: largest extent of the geometry.

referenceArea.description: m^2. Default: the shadow of the solid cells along the flow.

momentCenter.description: Default: the centre of the bounding box.

flowRate.description: Volume flow INTO the fluid, m^3/s.

speed.description: Mean speed into the fluid, m/s.

items.description: Exactly one of flowRate, speed and velocity.

flowRate.description: Volume flow OUT of the fluid, m^3/s, instead of a pressure.

speed.description: Mean speed out of the fluid, m/s, instead of a pressure.

items.description: A pressure, or a flow rate or speed. At least one outlet must be given by a pressure.

padding.description: Metres added around the bounds of the geometry.

referenceSpeed.description: m/s; sets the time step. Default: the fastest opening.

referenceLength.description: m, for the Reynolds number. Default: the diameter of the circle with the area of the first inlet.

acceleration.description: Body force per unit mass, m/s^2 (a duct driven by a pressure gradient, with periodic sides).

periodic.description: Axes whose two sides are joined.

motion.description: Surface velocity of a part, by part name. The solid does not move.

force.description: N on the fluid along axis.

items.description: An actuator disc: exactly one of force and pressureJump.

cellSize.description: m; used when it fits the budget.

latticeSpeed.description: Reference speed in cells per step. Default 0.06.

storage.description: auto (default): sparse when an internal study of cavities needs a box of more than 2^25 cells, else dense. sparse: only tiles of 8^3 cells near the cavities are stored (the box may then span up to 2^31 - 1 cells, at most 2^25 stored); the same bits as dense.

collision.description: auto (default) = regularized; trt: two relaxation times, for closed or periodic laminar flows (it diverged next to openings at small viscosity).

turbulence.description: auto (default): smagorinsky when the cell Reynolds number exceeds 10 and the Reynolds number exceeds 2000, else none.

wallFunction.description: With the sub-grid model: walls take a power-law wall function. Default true.

spongeCells.description: Cells in front of pressure sides over which the viscosity rises. Default 0.

thicken.description: Grow walls thinner than 1.44 cells so that they do not leak. Default true.

transits.description: Longest run, in transits. Default 8 external, 12 internal.

from.description: Internal, automatic seeds: the inlets to seed (default all).

items.description: Exactly one of position and fraction.

surface.description: Pressure and pressure coefficient at the vertices of the surface of every part.

history.description: false leaves the convergence history out. Default true.
